note: Menu Select replaces the core parent-item select by decorating the menu.parent_form_selector service and rendering a custom menu_select_tree form element. Its only config is menu_select.settings:search_enabled (boolean, default true) editable at /admin/config/content/menu_select, and its only permission is 'use menu select search' (restrict access: true). It has no configure route in info.yml (data.json configure=null) and defines no plugin types. Medium cases read back a toggled search_enabled and a role grant; hard cases set the config off and create a role with the permission, both verified against live state.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the menu_select module, which configuration object and key turn the parent-menu-link search box on or off, and at what admin path is the settings form?
evals.expected_output: The boolean menu_select.settings:search_enabled (default true) toggles the autocomplete search box; edit it at /admin/config/content/menu_select (route menu_select.menu_select_config_form) or via `drush config:set menu_select.settings search_enabled 0`.

evals.prompt: Which permission does the menu_select module define to gate its parent-link search feature, and is it a restricted permission?
evals.expected_output: menu_select defines the permission 'use menu select search' (machine name 'use menu select search'). It is marked restrict access: true, and granting it also lets the user view links across all menus via the autocomplete. The search textfield only renders when the user has this permission AND search_enabled is true.

evals.prompt: How does the menu_select module manage to replace the core 'Parent item' select list on every menu-link and node menu-settings form without patching core?
evals.expected_output: It decorates the core menu.parent_form_selector service (MenuSelectParentFormSelector extends MenuParentFormSelector). Its parentSelectElement() calls the inner service then swaps the element's #type to the custom menu_select_tree render element, so every place core asks for a parent picker gets the expandable tree/search widget instead.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the menu_select parent-link search box currently enabled or disabled? Inspect the live configuration and state the value of the relevant setting.
evals.expected_output: It is disabled: menu_select.settings:search_enabled is false on the live site (drush config:get menu_select.settings search_enabled).

evals.prompt: On this site, exactly one custom role has been granted the menu_select 'use menu select search' permission. Inspect the live role configuration and give the machine name of that role.
evals.expected_output: The role machine name is menu_select_searcher; it holds the 'use menu select search' permission (drush role:list, or inspect user.role.menu_select_searcher).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, disable the menu_select parent-link autocomplete search feature site-wide (leave only the tree widget). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set menu_select.settings:search_enabled to false (drush config:set menu_select.settings search_enabled 0 -y, or untick 'Enable searching for a menu link' at /admin/config/content/menu_select). Verified when the live config value is boolean false.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new role with machine name menu_select_navigator and grant it the menu_select 'use menu select search' permission. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create role menu_select_navigator (drush role:create menu_select_navigator) and add the permission (drush role:perm:add menu_select_navigator 'use menu select search'). Verified when the role exists and hasPermission('use menu select search') is true.
